description: This Java source file defines the ImagesController class, which handles HTTP requests related to serving image content from a sales management system. It provides endpoints to retrieve content images and product images based on URL parameters, interacting with content and product image services.

classes.name: ImagesController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling image HTTP requests, serving images from content storage or product image service based on URL parameters.

methods.name: printImage
methods.description: Handles requests for static images such as logos, content images, and product images by retrieving the appropriate image data using content and product image services.
